minecraft:infested_cobblestone: Cobblestone with a silverfish hiding inside. Breaking it releases the silverfish. It looks just like normal cobblestone but breaks faster.
minecraft:infested_stone_bricks: Stone bricks with a silverfish inside, common in strongholds. Breaking them releases the silverfish. They break faster than real stone bricks.
minecraft:infested_mossy_stone_bricks: Mossy stone bricks hiding a silverfish, found in strongholds. Breaking them releases the silverfish. They break faster than the real block.
minecraft:infested_cracked_stone_bricks: Cracked stone bricks hiding a silverfish, found in strongholds. Breaking them releases the silverfish. They break faster than the real block.
minecraft:infested_chiseled_stone_bricks: Chiseled stone bricks hiding a silverfish. Breaking them releases the silverfish. They break faster than the real block.
minecraft:infested_deepslate: Deepslate hiding a silverfish, found deep underground. Breaking it releases the silverfish. It breaks faster than real deepslate.
minecraft:stone_bricks: Neat stone bricks made from four stone. They are the main block of strongholds. Turn them mossy, crack them in a furnace, or chisel them.
minecraft:mossy_stone_bricks: Stone bricks overgrown with moss, found in strongholds and jungle temples. Craft stone bricks with a moss block or vines. They have stairs, slabs and walls.
minecraft:cracked_stone_bricks: Stone bricks with cracks across them. Smelt stone bricks in a furnace to crack them. They give builds a ruined, aged look.
minecraft:chiseled_stone_bricks: Stone bricks carved with a circular pattern. Craft two stone brick slabs stacked, or use a stonecutter. They are common in strongholds and trail ruins.
minecraft:packed_mud: Mud firmed up with wheat. Craft one mud and one wheat to make it. Four packed mud craft into mud bricks.
minecraft:mud_bricks: Earthy bricks made from packed mud. Craft four packed mud into four. They have stairs, slabs and walls and suit desert and swamp builds.
minecraft:deepslate_bricks: Dark bricks made from polished deepslate, common in ancient cities. Craft four polished deepslate into four. Smelt them for a cracked version.
minecraft:cracked_deepslate_bricks: Deepslate bricks with cracks across them. Smelt deepslate bricks to make them. They appear in ancient cities.
minecraft:deepslate_tiles: Small square tiles of deepslate. Craft four deepslate bricks into four tiles, or use a stonecutter. Smelt them for a cracked version.
minecraft:cracked_deepslate_tiles: Deepslate tiles with cracks across them. Smelt deepslate tiles to make them. They give builds a worn look.
minecraft:chiseled_deepslate: Deepslate carved with a decorative pattern. Craft two cobbled deepslate slabs stacked, or use a stonecutter. It appears in ancient cities.
minecraft:reinforced_deepslate: An indestructible block framing the strange portal in ancient cities. It can't be mined in Survival and survives any explosion. It can't be obtained without commands.
minecraft:brown_mushroom_block: The cap of a huge brown mushroom. Breaking it drops a few brown mushrooms. Collect the block itself with Silk Touch.
minecraft:red_mushroom_block: The spotted cap of a huge red mushroom. Breaking it drops a few red mushrooms. Collect the block itself with Silk Touch.
minecraft:mushroom_stem: The pale stem of a huge mushroom. It drops nothing unless mined with Silk Touch. It makes a nice off-white building block.
minecraft:iron_bars: A grid of iron bars that connects to its neighbours. Craft six iron ingots into sixteen. Use them for windows, cells and fences you can see through.
minecraft:chain: A short iron chain that can hang vertically or lie sideways. Craft it from an iron ingot and two iron nuggets. Hang lanterns and signs from it.
minecraft:glass_pane: A thin sheet of glass that connects to its neighbours. Craft six glass into sixteen panes. It makes slim windows.
minecraft:melon: A whole melon grown from melon seeds. Breaking it drops several melon slices. Nine slices craft back into a melon.
minecraft:vine: Leafy vines that hang from trees in jungles and swamps. You can climb them, and they slowly spread. Collect them with shears.
minecraft:glow_lichen: A faintly glowing lichen that grows on cave walls. It gives off dim light. Collect it with shears, or spread it with bone meal.
minecraft:brick_stairs: Stairs made of bricks. Craft six brick blocks in a stair shape, or use a stonecutter. They make cosy, classic roofs.
minecraft:stone_brick_stairs: Stairs made of stone bricks. Craft six stone bricks in a stair shape, or use a stonecutter. They are common in strongholds.
minecraft:mud_brick_stairs: Stairs made of mud bricks. Craft six mud bricks in a stair shape, or use a stonecutter. They suit earthy builds.
minecraft:mycelium: A purple-grey soil found only in mushroom fields. Mushrooms grow on it in any light, and it spreads onto nearby dirt. Without Silk Touch it drops dirt.
minecraft:lily_pad: A floating leaf found on swamp water. Place it on water to walk across. Boats break lily pads on contact.
minecraft:nether_bricks: Dark red bricks that make up nether fortresses. Smelt netherrack into nether brick items, then craft four into a block. They resist fire and ghast fireballs.
minecraft:cracked_nether_bricks: Nether bricks with cracks across them. Smelt nether bricks to make them. They appear in bastion remnants.
minecraft:chiseled_nether_bricks: Nether bricks carved with a skull-like pattern. Craft two nether brick slabs stacked, or use a stonecutter. They appear in bastion remnants.
minecraft:nether_brick_fence: A dark fence of nether bricks, found in nether fortresses. Craft four nether brick blocks and two nether bricks into six. It doesn't connect to wooden fences.
minecraft:nether_brick_stairs: Stairs made of nether bricks, found in nether fortresses. Craft six nether brick blocks in a stair shape, or use a stonecutter. They don't burn.
minecraft:sculk: A dark, pulsing block that spreads across the deep dark. It drops experience when mined; Silk Touch collects it. A hoe mines it fastest.
minecraft:sculk_vein: A thin layer of sculk that creeps over surfaces. It drops nothing unless mined with Silk Touch. It spreads when a sculk catalyst blooms nearby.
minecraft:sculk_catalyst: A sculk block that blooms when a mob dies nearby, spreading sculk with the dead mob's experience. It drops experience when mined. Silk Touch collects it.
minecraft:sculk_shrieker: A sculk block that shrieks when a nearby sculk sensor detects a player. Natural shriekers can summon the Warden and give darkness. Placed shriekers just shriek.
minecraft:enchanting_table: A table made from a book, two diamonds and four obsidian. Spend lapis lazuli and experience levels to enchant tools, weapons and armor. Bookshelves around it unlock stronger enchantments.
minecraft:end_portal_frame: The frame of the End portal, found in a stronghold's portal room. Fill all twelve frames with eyes of ender to open the portal. It can't be broken in Survival.
minecraft:end_stone: The pale stone of the End's islands. It resists explosions well. Craft four into end stone bricks.
minecraft:end_stone_bricks: Bricks made from end stone, found in End cities. Craft four end stone into four. They have stairs, slabs and walls.
minecraft:dragon_egg: A unique egg left on the exit portal after the Ender Dragon is first defeated. It teleports away when hit or clicked. Push it with a piston or let it drop onto a torch to collect it.
minecraft:sandstone_stairs: Stairs made of sandstone. Craft six sandstone in a stair shape, or use a stonecutter. They are common in desert villages.
minecraft:ender_chest: A chest made from eight obsidian and an eye of ender. Every ender chest opens the same private inventory, wherever you are. Without Silk Touch it drops eight obsidian.
minecraft:emerald_block: Nine emeralds packed into a block. It stores emeralds compactly. It also works as a beacon base.
minecraft:oak_stairs: Stairs made of oak planks. Craft six planks in a stair shape for four stairs. They also burn as fuel.
minecraft:spruce_stairs: Stairs made of spruce planks. Craft six planks in a stair shape for four stairs. They suit cabins and taiga builds.
minecraft:birch_stairs: Stairs made of birch planks. Craft six planks in a stair shape for four stairs. They give a light, clean look.
minecraft:jungle_stairs: Stairs made of jungle planks. Craft six planks in a stair shape for four stairs. They suit warm, reddish builds.
minecraft:acacia_stairs: Stairs made of acacia planks. Craft six planks in a stair shape for four stairs. They add a bright orange accent.
minecraft:cherry_stairs: Stairs made of cherry planks. Craft six planks in a stair shape for four stairs. They suit soft pink builds.
minecraft:dark_oak_stairs: Stairs made of dark oak planks. Craft six planks in a stair shape for four stairs. They suit rich, dark builds.
minecraft:mangrove_stairs: Stairs made of mangrove planks. Craft six planks in a stair shape for four stairs. They suit red-toned builds.
minecraft:bamboo_stairs: Stairs made of bamboo planks. Craft six planks in a stair shape for four stairs. They suit bright, tropical builds.
minecraft:bamboo_mosaic_stairs: Stairs made of bamboo mosaic. Craft six mosaic blocks in a stair shape for four stairs. They keep the woven pattern.
minecraft:crimson_stairs: Stairs made of crimson planks. Craft six planks in a stair shape for four stairs. Like all Nether wood, they never burn.
minecraft:warped_stairs: Stairs made of warped planks. Craft six planks in a stair shape for four stairs. Like all Nether wood, they never burn.
minecraft:command_block: A block that runs commands when powered by redstone. It can only be obtained with commands in Creative mode. Map makers use it to build games and contraptions.
minecraft:beacon: A powerful light crafted from glass, obsidian and a nether star. Placed on a pyramid of iron, gold, diamond, emerald or netherite blocks, it grants effects such as speed or haste to nearby players. Bigger pyramids unlock more effects and range.
minecraft:cobblestone_wall: A wall of cobblestone that connects to its neighbours. Craft six cobblestone into six walls. Mobs can't jump over it.
minecraft:mossy_cobblestone_wall: A wall of mossy cobblestone. Craft six mossy cobblestone into six walls, or use a stonecutter. Mobs can't jump over it.
minecraft:brick_wall: A wall of bricks. Craft six brick blocks into six walls, or use a stonecutter. Mobs can't jump over it.
minecraft:prismarine_wall: A wall of prismarine. Craft six prismarine into six walls, or use a stonecutter. Its color slowly shifts like the original block.
minecraft:red_sandstone_wall: A wall of red sandstone. Craft six red sandstone into six walls, or use a stonecutter. It suits badlands builds.
minecraft:mossy_stone_brick_wall: A wall of mossy stone bricks. Craft six mossy stone bricks into six walls, or use a stonecutter. It suits ruins and overgrown builds.
minecraft:granite_wall: A wall of granite. Craft six granite into six walls, or use a stonecutter. Mobs can't jump over it.
minecraft:stone_brick_wall: A wall of stone bricks. Craft six stone bricks into six walls, or use a stonecutter. Mobs can't jump over it.
minecraft:mud_brick_wall: A wall of mud bricks. Craft six mud bricks into six walls, or use a stonecutter. It suits earthy builds.
minecraft:nether_brick_wall: A wall of nether bricks. Craft six nether brick blocks into six walls, or use a stonecutter. It doesn't burn.
minecraft:andesite_wall: A wall of andesite. Craft six andesite into six walls, or use a stonecutter. Mobs can't jump over it.
minecraft:red_nether_brick_wall: A wall of red nether bricks. Craft six red nether bricks into six walls, or use a stonecutter. It doesn't burn.
minecraft:sandstone_wall: A wall of sandstone. Craft six sandstone into six walls, or use a stonecutter. It suits desert builds.
minecraft:end_stone_brick_wall: A wall of end stone bricks. Craft six end stone bricks into six walls, or use a stonecutter. It resists explosions well.
minecraft:diorite_wall: A wall of diorite. Craft six diorite into six walls, or use a stonecutter. Mobs can't jump over it.
minecraft:blackstone_wall: A wall of blackstone. Craft six blackstone into six walls, or use a stonecutter. It suits dark, Nether-style builds.
minecraft:polished_blackstone_wall: A wall of polished blackstone. Craft six polished blackstone into six walls, or use a stonecutter. Mobs can't jump over it.
minecraft:polished_blackstone_brick_wall: A wall of polished blackstone bricks. Craft six bricks into six walls, or use a stonecutter. It is common in bastion remnants.
minecraft:cobbled_deepslate_wall: A wall of cobbled deepslate. Craft six cobbled deepslate into six walls, or use a stonecutter. Mobs can't jump over it.
minecraft:polished_deepslate_wall: A wall of polished deepslate. Craft six polished deepslate into six walls, or use a stonecutter. Mobs can't jump over it.
minecraft:deepslate_brick_wall: A wall of deepslate bricks. Craft six deepslate bricks into six walls, or use a stonecutter. It suits ancient city builds.
minecraft:deepslate_tile_wall: A wall of deepslate tiles. Craft six deepslate tiles into six walls, or use a stonecutter. Mobs can't jump over it.
minecraft:anvil: A heavy block made from three blocks of iron and four iron ingots. Use it to repair, rename and combine enchanted items for experience. It wears out with use and falls like sand.
minecraft:chipped_anvil: An anvil that has started to wear out. It works like a new anvil. A few more uses or a long fall will damage it further.
minecraft:damaged_anvil: An anvil close to breaking. It still works, but its next damage destroys it. Replace it soon.
minecraft:chiseled_quartz_block: A quartz block carved with a pattern. Craft two quartz slabs stacked, or use a stonecutter. It makes elegant columns and accents.
minecraft:quartz_block: A clean white block made from four nether quartz. It is the base for quartz pillars, bricks and stairs. Smelt it for smooth quartz.
minecraft:quartz_bricks: Quartz shaped into bricks. Craft four quartz blocks into four, or use a stonecutter. They give white builds more texture.
minecraft:quartz_pillar: A ribbed column of quartz. Craft two quartz blocks stacked, or use a stonecutter. Place it sideways for horizontal beams.
minecraft:quartz_stairs: Stairs made of quartz. Craft six quartz blocks in a stair shape, or use a stonecutter. They suit clean, modern builds.
minecraft:white_terracotta: Terracotta dyed white. Craft eight terracotta around white dye, or find it in badlands. Smelt it into white glazed terracotta.
minecraft:orange_terracotta: Terracotta dyed orange, common in badlands. Craft eight terracotta around orange dye. Smelt it into orange glazed terracotta.
minecraft:magenta_terracotta: Terracotta dyed magenta. Craft eight terracotta around magenta dye. Smelt it into magenta glazed terracotta.
minecraft:light_blue_terracotta: Terracotta dyed light blue. Craft eight terracotta around light blue dye. Smelt it into light blue glazed terracotta.
minecraft:yellow_terracotta: Terracotta dyed yellow, common in badlands. Craft eight terracotta around yellow dye. Smelt it into yellow glazed terracotta.
minecraft:lime_terracotta: Terracotta dyed lime. Craft eight terracotta around lime dye. Smelt it into lime glazed terracotta.
minecraft:pink_terracotta: Terracotta dyed pink. Craft eight terracotta around pink dye. Smelt it into pink glazed terracotta.
minecraft:gray_terracotta: Terracotta dyed gray. Craft eight terracotta around gray dye. Smelt it into gray glazed terracotta.
minecraft:light_gray_terracotta: Terracotta dyed light gray, found in badlands. Craft eight terracotta around light gray dye. Smelt it into light gray glazed terracotta.
minecraft:cyan_terracotta: Terracotta dyed cyan. Craft eight terracotta around cyan dye. Smelt it into cyan glazed terracotta.
minecraft:purple_terracotta: Terracotta dyed purple. Craft eight terracotta around purple dye. Smelt it into purple glazed terracotta.
minecraft:blue_terracotta: Terracotta dyed blue. Craft eight terracotta around blue dye. Smelt it into blue glazed terracotta.
minecraft:brown_terracotta: Terracotta dyed brown, found in badlands. Craft eight terracotta around brown dye. Smelt it into brown glazed terracotta.
minecraft:green_terracotta: Terracotta dyed green. Craft eight terracotta around green dye. Smelt it into green glazed terracotta.
minecraft:red_terracotta: Terracotta dyed red, common in badlands. Craft eight terracotta around red dye. Smelt it into red glazed terracotta.
minecraft:black_terracotta: Terracotta dyed black. Craft eight terracotta around black dye. Smelt it into black glazed terracotta.
minecraft:barrier: An invisible, unbreakable block used by map makers. It blocks movement but can't be seen without holding one. It can only be obtained with commands.
minecraft:light: An invisible block that gives off light, used by map makers. Its brightness can be set from 0 to 15. It can only be obtained with commands.
minecraft:hay_block: Nine wheat bundled into a bale. Horses and llamas eat it, and it softens falls a lot. Placed under a campfire, it makes the smoke rise much higher.
